summary.goal: Add a compact reply bar above the conversation input showing pending items that need user response.

acceptance_criteria.description: ReplyBar renders between ConversationMessages and ConversationInput
Pending questions from agents accumulate as compact one-line items
Each item shows: agent name, question summary, time waiting
Clicking an item navigates to the relevant context (agent tab, tree node, or scrolls to question in conversation)
ReplyBar hidden when no pending items exist
Items persist until explicitly addressed (answered or dismissed)
Reply bar adapts the question pipeline from planner-ui (useQuestionQueue pattern)

observations: planner-ui has a TriagePanel for managing pending questions
In tend, this becomes the ReplyBar — a more subtle, inline element above the chat input rather than a floating panel
The data source is the same: useQuestionQueue polls SSE for pending questions
The rendering is different: compact text lines instead of cards
This bridges the status bar bubbles (transient attention) with the persistent question queue
ReplyBar is essentially a simplified TriagePanel with different positioning and styling
questions: Should clicking an item auto-focus the input with context?
Do we allow dismissing questions or only answering?
Should the reply bar show a count when collapsed?

steps.title: Create ReplyBar component
steps.description: Create packages/tend/src/components/conversation/ReplyBar.tsx. Positioned between ConversationMessages and ConversationInput. Renders compact one-line rows for pending items. Each row: agent name, question summary (truncated), time waiting. Hidden when no items. Minimal styling, blends with conversation.

steps.title: Adapt useQuestionQueue hook from planner-ui
steps.description: Copy packages/planner-ui/src/hooks/useQuestionQueue.ts → packages/tend/src/hooks/useQuestionQueue.ts. SSE polling for pending questions. Adapt API endpoint to project-scoped questions. Wire to ReplyBar for pending items list. Items persist until addressed.

steps.title: Render pending items in ReplyBar
steps.description: In ReplyBar: map pending questions from useQuestionQueue to compact rows. Show agent name, truncate question to ~40 chars, show elapsed time (e.g., '2m ago'). Use attention level 2 styling (noticeable but not raised).

steps.title: Wire click navigation to context
steps.description: In ReplyBar item onClick: navigate to relevant context. If question from agent → open agent tab. If question references tree node → zoom to node. If question is in conversation history → scroll to message. Use question metadata (step_refs, agent_id) for routing.

steps.title: Hide ReplyBar when empty
steps.description: In ReplyBar: check pending items length. Render null when empty. Add fade-in/fade-out transition when items appear/disappear. Test with no questions, one question, multiple questions.

architect.source_pattern: planner-ui TriagePanel → simplified to inline ReplyBar
architect.rendering_style: compact text lines with minimal styling, not cards
architect.interaction: clicking navigates to context (tree node, agent tab, or scroll to message)
architect.persistence: items remain until answered or dismissed
architect.visibility: hidden when empty, revealed when items present
